tools.name: keys.create
tools.description: Mint a pf_ caller key bound to one HoldKit namespace. The raw key is shown once. Pass this key on every later tools/call. Send it as the caller_key argument.

tools.name: inbox.create
tools.description: Create an inbox. Returns webhook and A2A URLs. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: inbox.poll
tools.description: Read inbox events after a cursor. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: inbox.ack
tools.description: Mark inbox events done. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: inbox.wait
tools.description: Poll an inbox. block_ms is accepted and capped at 0 in this MVP, so the call returns current events. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: timer.set
tools.description: Schedule a durable timer. Delivery URLs must be public https. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: timer.cancel
tools.description: Cancel a timer. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: lock.acquire
tools.description: Take a lease lock. Returns a fencing token. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: lock.release
tools.description: Release a lock with its fencing token. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: idem.begin
tools.description: Start an idempotency key or return the prior outcome. fingerprint is a hex hash. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: idem.commit
tools.description: Store the outcome reference for an idempotency key. scope (max 64) and owner are optional. When owner is omitted, the caller key hash is sent. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: kv.get
tools.description: Read a small value. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: kv.set
tools.description: Write a small value with a TTL. Emails and card numbers are rejected. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

tools.name: kv.delete
tools.description: Delete a value. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: inbox.poll · Private data: lock.acquire, lock.release · Public sink: keys.create, inbox.create · Destructive: kv.delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: inbox.poll · Private data: lock.acquire, lock.release · Public sink: keys.create, inbox.create · Destructive: kv.delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "keys.create" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Mint a pf_ caller key bound to one HoldKit namespace. The raw key is shown once. Pass this key on every later tools/call." → after: "Mint a pf_ caller key bound to one HoldKit namespace. The raw key is shown once. Pass this key on every later tools/call. Send it as the caller_key argument."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
